on_actions = {
	on_monthly_ITA = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = ITA
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_initialized
					check_variable = { global.num_days > global.COLDWAR_ITA_month_next_day }
				}
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_ITA_month_next_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_ITA_month_next_day = 25 }
				COLDWAR_ITA_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
